description: 连接企查查企业信息、风险、知识产权、经营和董监高服务。

steps: Qichacha uses the Yuanjing Digital Employee OAuth client for this local runtime.
Register this runtime's exact callback URL in the Qichacha OAuth app before signing in.
After signing in, one grant can be used across the Qichacha resource set.

actions.name: call_tool
actions.description: Call a current Qichacha MCP tool with JSON arguments. Discover the live schema first, then choose the matching resource group before calling.

resource.description: The Qichacha MCP resource group to inspect or call. Defaults to company.

toolName.description: The exact tool name returned by Qichacha MCP discovery.

arguments.description: JSON arguments matching the current inputSchema for the selected Qichacha MCP tool.

inputSchema.description: Input for invoking one current Qichacha MCP tool.

resource.description: The Qichacha MCP resource group to inspect or call. Defaults to company.

result.description: The current Qichacha MCP result after standard MCP content normalization.

outputSchema.description: The normalized result returned by the Qichacha MCP tool.

actions.name: list_tools
actions.description: List the current tool catalog and live input schemas exposed by one Qichacha MCP resource group.

resource.description: The Qichacha MCP resource group to inspect or call. Defaults to company.

inputSchema.description: Input for discovering Qichacha MCP tools.

resource.description: The Qichacha MCP resource group to inspect or call. Defaults to company.

name.description: The exact Qichacha MCP tool name to pass to call_tool.

description.description: The current tool description supplied by Qichacha.

title.description: A human-readable title for the tool.

readOnlyHint.description: Whether Qichacha expects the tool not to modify data.

destructiveHint.description: Whether Qichacha indicates that the tool may be destructive.

idempotentHint.description: Whether repeated calls with the same arguments are idempotent.

openWorldHint.description: Whether the tool may interact with external entities.

annotations.description: MCP behavior hints supplied by Qichacha for a tool.

inputSchema.description: The current JSON Schema for the tool arguments, supplied by Qichacha MCP.

items.description: A tool currently exposed by Qichacha MCP.

tools.description: Tools currently exposed by the selected MCP resource.

outputSchema.description: The current Qichacha MCP tool catalog for the selected resource.
